description_en: Queries flow logs in a specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribeFlowLogs查询指定地域下流日志实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-flow-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --flow-log-id fl-7a56mar1kfw9vj0000 --flow-log-name DDE --description desc --status Active --output-type all --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFlowLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region that the flow logs are stored
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of a flow log
parameters.name: flow_log_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the flow log
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the flow log
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The status of the flow log. Valid values:

Active: The flow log is enabled.
Inactive: The flow log is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
流日志实例状态，取值：

Active：已启动。

Inactive：未启动
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The location where the flow log is stored. Valid values:

sls: The flow log is stored in Log Service.
netflow: The flow log is stored on a NetFlow collector.
all: The flow log is stored both in Log Service and on a NetFlow collector
parameters.help_zh:
流日志输出类型，取值：

sls：流日志存储在阿里云日志服务中。

netflow：流日志存储在您配置的NetFlow服务器上。

all：流日志同时存储在阿里云日志服务和您配置的NetFlow服务器上
parameters.name: output_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

ActiveAging.description_en: The output interval under active connections. Unit: seconds
ActiveAging.description_zh: 活跃流输出间隔。单位：秒

Description.description_en: The description of the flow log

FlowLogId.description_en: The ID of the flow log

InactiveAging.description_en: The output interval under inactive connections. Unit: seconds
InactiveAging.description_zh: 非活跃流输出间隔。单位：秒

LogstoreName.description_en: The name of the Logstore in Log Service
LogstoreName.description_zh: 日志服务的日志库名称

Name.description_en: The name of the flow log

NetflowServerIp.description_en: The address of the NetFlow collector where the flow log is stored
NetflowServerIp.description_zh: 存储流日志的Netflow服务器地址

NetflowServerPort.description_en: The port number of the NetFlow collector that stores the flow log. Default value: 9995
NetflowServerPort.description_zh: 存储流日志的Netflow服务器端口，默认值为9995

NetflowVersion.description_en: The protocol version number of the NetFlow collector that stores the flow log. Default value: V9
NetflowVersion.description_zh: 存储流日志的Netflow协议版本号，默认值为V9

OutputType.description_en:
The location where the flow log is stored. Valid values:

sls: The flow log is stored in Log Service.
netflow: The flow log is stored on a NetFlow collector.
all: The flow log is stored both in Log Service and on a NetFlow collector
OutputType.description_zh:
流日志输出类型。

sls：流日志存储在阿里云日志服务中。

netflow：流日志存储在您配置的Netflow服务器上。

all：流日志同时存储在阿里云日志服务和您配置的Netflow服务器上

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the Log Service project

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the flow log belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 流日志实例所属的资源组ID

SlsRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region that the Log Service is deployed

Status.description_en:
The status of the flow log. Valid values:

Active: The flow log is enabled.
Inactive: The flow log is disabled
Status.description_zh:
流日志实例的状态：

Active：已启动。

Inactive：未启动

TotalSagNum.description_en: The number of Smart Access gateway (SAG) instances with which the flow log is associated
TotalSagNum.description_zh: 流日志实例关联的智能接入网关实例数目

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of flow logs
